title: A Weekend at the Animal Shelter（動物收容所的週末）
passage:
Last Saturday, Ben went to the city animal shelter to volunteer for the first time. He used to think taking care of dogs was easy, but he quickly learned it was a big responsibility.

When Ben arrived, a worker named Ms. Lin showed him around. Some dogs were sleeping quietly, but others barked loudly at every stranger who walked by. "Don't worry," said Ms. Lin. "If you stay calm and gentle, the dogs will trust you soon."

Ben's first job was to feed the dogs and give each one fresh water. He put a leash on a small, nervous dog named Coco to take her for a walk. Coco used to live on the street as a stray before she was rescued last month. At first, she was too scared to leave her cage, but Ben spoke softly to her so that she would feel safe.

By the afternoon, Ben was exhausted, but he felt proud. "If more people come to adopt these dogs, they can finally have a real home," Ms. Lin said. Ben smiled and promised to come back next weekend.

On the bus home, Ben told his sister about his day. "It was hard work," he said, "but it was completely worthwhile. I used to think shelters were sad places, but now I know they're full of hope."

It is Amy's job to feed the puppies every morning.

Ms. Lin spoke in a gentle voice so the dogs would not be scared.
The shelter workers rescue animals that are hurt or lost.

Helping the animals made the whole day feel worthwhile.

grammar: 假設語氣 First Conditional（If + 現在式動詞, ... will + 原形動詞）：表示條件成立時，很可能發生的未來結果。If 子句用現在式動詞，主要子句用「will + 原形動詞」。例如：If you stay calm and gentle, the dogs will trust you soon.；If more people come to adopt these dogs, they can finally have a real home.；If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
used to + 原形動詞：表示過去的習慣或狀態，現在已經不同或不再如此，後面一定接原形動詞。例如：Ben used to think taking care of dogs was easy.；Coco used to live on the street as a stray.；I used to think shelters were sad places.

不定詞表目的 (to + 原形動詞) 與 so that + 子句表目的：兩者都可說明做某事的目的。「to V」直接接在動詞後方；「so that + 子句」則引導一個完整的子句來說明目的。例如：Ben went to the shelter to volunteer for the first time.；He put a leash on Coco to take her for a walk.；Ben spoke softly to her so that she would feel safe.

reading.q: Why did Ben go to the animal shelter last Saturday?
opts: To adopt a dog for his family
To volunteer for the first time
reading.ex: 文中第一句提到 Ben went to the city animal shelter to volunteer for the first time，他是去當志工，不是去領養或買東西。

reading.q: What was Ben's first job at the shelter?
opts: To walk all the dogs at once
To feed the dogs and give them water
reading.ex: 文中提到 Ben's first job was to feed the dogs and give each one fresh water，第一份工作是餵食和給水。

reading.q: What happened to Coco before she was rescued?
opts: She lived in a nice house
She used to live on the street as a stray
She was born at the shelter
reading.ex: 文中提到 Coco used to live on the street as a stray before she was rescued last month，她原本是流浪街頭的浪浪。

reading.q: How did Ben feel by the afternoon?
reading.ex: 文中提到 By the afternoon, Ben was exhausted, but he felt proud，他覺得累但很驕傲。

reading.q: What did Ben tell his sister about his day at the shelter?
opts: It was a waste of time
It was hard work but worthwhile
reading.ex: 文中提到 It was hard work, but it was completely worthwhile，Ben 認為雖然辛苦但很值得。

grammar.q: "___ you stay calm and gentle, the dogs will trust you soon."
grammar.ex: 假設語氣的條件句要用 If 開頭，表示「如果」，後方主要子句用 will + 原形動詞。

grammar.q: Coco ___ live on the street as a stray before she was rescued.
grammar.ex: 「used to + 原形動詞」表示過去的習慣或狀態，故選 used to。

grammar.q: Ben spoke softly to her ___ she would feel safe.
grammar.ex: so that + 完整子句用來表示「目的」，其餘選項後面不能直接接完整子句。

grammar.q: Ben went to the shelter ___ volunteer for the first time.
grammar.ex: 不定詞 to + 原形動詞可表示目的，相當於中文「去做某事」。

grammar.q: If more people ___ to adopt these dogs, they can finally have a real home.
grammar.ex: 第一類條件句的 if 子句要用現在式動詞，故選 come。

vocab.q: "shelter" 這個字的中文意思最接近？
vocab.ex: shelter 指提供保護或住所的地方，文中指「動物收容所」。

vocab.q: 選出與 "stray" 意思最接近的選項：
vocab.ex: stray 指「流浪的、無家可歸的」，最接近 lost and homeless。

vocab.q: "Ben was ___ by the afternoon, but he felt proud." 依句意選出最適合的字：
vocab.ex: 句意指 Ben 到下午時感到「精疲力盡」，應選 exhausted。
adopt 指「領養」，例如領養一隻寵物。
